method: 50 full-flush English explanations enumerate exact winning shapes for accepted discards. 120 casual explanations are edited translations reviewed against the supplied hand and accepted discard. Source strategy rankings/probabilities have not been independently simulated. Original Japanese and answer keys remain unchanged.

issues.issue: Original starts with discard 1, but the hand contains no 1; accepted discard is 8p. English waits are calculated from the accepted discard.
Original references a Bamboo shape absent from the hand; English refers to Characters and the actual Bamboo block.
Original 1–7s wait was corrected to 4s/7s for the stated dora-Pon shape.
Original calls 5m red but tiles_str does not mark it red; English avoids that unverified detail.
Original says discard 7m, absent from the hand; accepted 7s is retained and unsupported numeric claims omitted.
Original explanation describes other suits/discards than this hand. English describes the actual accepted 8s discard and Red Dragon pair.
Original recommends 2p and says four pairs, inconsistent with accepted 4m and the three actual pairs. English describes the accepted discard without repeating those claims.
